sentences.text: Counsel for the Petitioner submits that an amended memo of parties shall be filed impleading the Complainant as a co-Respondent.
It is submitted that the Petitioner is the sister-in-law of the Complainant and was not residing with her at the relevant time.
The Petitioner had married prior to the Complainant's marriage and was residing separately in her own matrimonial home.
On this basis, it is urged that the Petitioner has been unnecessarily implicated in the present case.
Reliance is placed on the judgment of the Supreme Court in Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam v. State of Bihar.1

sentences.text: 6. Issue notice.
Mr. Mukesh Kumar, APP for the State, accepts notice.
7. Status report, if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.
8. Upon filing of the amended memo of parties and process fee, issue notice to the Complainant by all permissible modes, returnable on 23rd February, 2026.
